data_partition.design: 11 pediatric OSA participants versus 11 pediatric controls
data_partition.covariates: none; individual-level age, sex, BMI, and AHI are not available in the frozen local manifest
data_partition.integration_role: visualization or annotation diagnostics only; never the differential-expression sampling unit

technical_QC.doublet_policy: fixed high-complexity exclusion proxy only; no outcome-dependent thresholding and no claim of complete doublet identification
technical_QC.ambient_RNA_policy: marker ambiguity and unassigned labels are retained; no outcome-dependent ambient correction
technical_QC.sample_exclusion: no participant is excluded after viewing disease effects; technical gate failure blocks formal endpoint execution

annotation.method: deterministic normalized marker-module scoring without disease labels, candidate identities, or frozen pair ranks
annotation.interpretation: primary broad lineages are used for formal validation; fine labels are secondary localization diagnostics and do not imply a reference-atlas-quality annotation

pseudobulk.aggregation: sum raw UMI counts within each participant and cell lineage
pseudobulk.gene_filter: CPM at least 1 in at least 5 eligible participants within the lineage
pseudobulk.primary_model: intercept plus OSA indicator on participant-level logCPM
pseudobulk.primary_statistic: limma-style empirical-Bayes moderated t using the frozen project implementation
pseudobulk.candidate_mapping: exact version-stripped Ensembl gene identifier first; current gene symbol is audit-only fallback

cell_context_endpoint.discovery_orientation: sign of frozen adult GSE75097 OSA-minus-control beta
cell_context_endpoint.node_score: within-lineage midrank percentile of discovery-oriented pediatric moderated t among measurable frozen candidates
cell_context_endpoint.pair_score: geometric mean of the two node scores
cell_context_endpoint.primary_omnibus: mean top-minus-background pair support across T_NK, B, and Myeloid at the frozen top 1 percent
cell_context_endpoint.AUEC: mean normalized trapezoidal area of top-minus-background support across the three primary lineages
cell_context_endpoint.lineage_specific_results: secondary; report all prespecified lineages and BH-adjust across the three primary lineages
cell_context_endpoint.cell_type_localization: external transcript-level cell-context support only; not physical PPI validation

randomization.primary_node_aware: jointly permute each candidate's complete three-lineage evidence vector within deterministic blocks matched on pediatric detection and frozen protein length; preserve pair graph and frozen ranks
randomization.participant_label: permute the complete 11 OSA and 11 control participant labels jointly across all primary lineages and recompute candidate and pair statistics
randomization.P_value: (1 plus number of null statistics at least as large as observed) divided by (iterations plus 1)

preprocess_PASS: all samples share the same 36601-feature table
technical and annotation QC thresholds pass
each primary lineage has at least 30 cells in every participant
pseudobulk participant columns remain 11 control and 11 OSA

prohibited: changing candidate or pair membership, frozen ranking, model weights, top fractions, annotation rules, QC thresholds, or endpoint orientation after viewing pediatric effects
using GSE214865 for training, calibration, threshold selection, checkpoint selection, early stopping, or model selection
treating individual cells as independent biological replicates
calling transcript co-localization physical protein interaction validation
selecting only the best-looking cell lineage
removing adult candidates because pediatric validation is absent or opposite
